headline: Exchange Forum: Giving young people more confidence to become parents
summary: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced extended parental leave, child support top-ups, lower preschool fees and enhanced housing and caregiving support. The measures aim to ease the economic, time and caregiving burden on parents.
why: Government family policy affects labour supply, household spending and public finances, all of which matter to Singapore's economic outlook.
